description:
The T8 housing bracket model is loaded in FreeCAD. Your task is to prepare this part for 3D printing by splitting it into two separate solid bodies at a height of Z = 15 mm. 

1. Split the model horizontally at Z = 15 mm. 
2. Export the bottom section (everything below Z=15) to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/bracket_bottom.stl'.
3. Export the top section (everything above Z=15) to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/bracket_top.stl'.

You can use any method to split the part (e.g., Part Slice, Slice apart, or Boolean Cut with a plane/box), as long as the resulting mesh files are correct.
